notes: Box score from the Covers matchup page for the Grizzlies' 115–97 win over the Clippers on Nov 25, 2026: all 115 Memphis points and all 97 L.A. points add up from the player lines, as do the shooting totals (46 of 94, 11 of 42 from three, 12 of 14 FT for Memphis; 33 of 85, 6 of 30, 25 of 28 for L.A.), rebounds (44–48), assists (23–20), steals (8–1), blocks (7–3) and turnovers (7–12). The final and the quarter scores (32–18–32–33 to 15–28–26–28) also match the FOX Sports box score; 50–43 at the half and 82–69 after three follow from them. Points in the paint (60–50) are on Covers, FOX Sports and Roundtable Sports. Memphis' biggest lead, 22, is on Covers and in Roundtable Sports; L.A. never led (FOX Sports play-by-play). Memphis' bench points (50) are added up from the Covers box score. Records are from Covers and the site's standings after Wednesday's games.

The 18–2 third-quarter run, from 50–48 at 10:06 to 68–50 at 6:36, is in the FOX Sports play-by-play and the AP, Roundtable Sports and The Sports Leader stories. Memphis has won seven of eight (The Sports Leader) and is 2–1 in NBA Cup Group B (AP; Roundtable Sports); the Clippers have lost five straight (The Sports Leader) and are 0–9 on the road (AP). Zach Edey left with left ankle soreness and didn't play the second half (Daily Memphian; Roundtable Sports). Brandon Ingram scored 18 for L.A. (AP). Next: Memphis visits Minnesota on Friday, with the group on the line (AP); Minnesota beat Memphis 104–95 on Nov 21 (the site's results). L.A. hosts New Orleans on Friday (AP).

The play of the game is an original illustration of Cam Spencer's driving floater with 4:40 left that made it 104–82: the FOX Sports play-by-play has "Cam Spencer makes two point driving floating jump shot" at 4:40 for 104–82, his third straight Memphis basket, and The Sports Leader says the lead reached 22 on Spencer's floater with 4:40 left. So the board's Grizzlies +20 to +22 is 102–82 to 104–82. No assist is listed and the defender isn't described, so it is drawn as the template's plain drive to a short finish. The figures are stylized and not traced from footage, and the spacing is not to scale.

The music is an original beat made for this page. No existing recordings or melodies are used. This is an unofficial fan recap, not affiliated with the Memphis Grizzlies or the NBA, which is why it carries a plain basketball mark and the team's colors but not the team's logo.

The player in the play of the game is drawn to Spencer's listed 6-foot-3 and 205 pounds (RealGM; Wikipedia lists 6-foot-4), with arms at the default length because no wingspan is reported, in the Grizzlies' home kit with No. 24 (RealGM) and a lighter skin tone; he has no approved look yet. It is an original figure with a featureless face, not a portrait or a trace of footage.
